MS Dhoni apni shandar kaptani ke sath-sath hazirajvabi, mazakiya andaz aur kam bolne ke lie bhi jane jate hain. pres konphrens men unke chutile javabon se lekar mushkil paristhitiyon men kutnitik tarike se bat sanbhalne tak, janie dhoni ke vyaktitv ke aise pahlu, jo unhen baki khilariyon se alag banate hain.
Thank you for watching our video!
